name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage smell in my house?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage smell in my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a sewage smell varies widely depending on the underlying cause. Simple fixes, like refilling a dry P-trap, cost nothing. Minor plumbing repairs, such as sealing a small leak, might range from $100 to $300. More complex issues, like repairing a cracked sewer line or a blocked vent pipe, could cost several hundred to a few thousand dollars, especially if excavation or extensive pipe replacement is required. A professional diagnosis is essential for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary from free for a dry P-trap to hundreds or thousands for complex repairs like sewer line issues, depending on the problem's severity.
